gloss: a certain company; an unnamed company

definitions.gloss: a certain company; an unnamed company
definitions.explanation: Used to refer to a company whose name is deliberately left unspecified, either because it is irrelevant, confidential, or the speaker wants to avoid naming it directly.

examples.japanese: {某社|ぼうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}めている→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: I work for a certain company.

examples.japanese: {某社|ぼうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不具合|ふぐあい}→不具合：06413_fuguai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A defect was found in a certain company's product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧{某社|ぼうしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{内定|ないてい}→内定：07499_naitei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧らしい。
examples.english: I heard they got a job offer from a major company whose name I won't mention.

notes:
Part of a series of ⟦{某|ぼう}→某：19351_bou⟧〜 words used to keep names anonymous. Common in news articles, online discussions, and casual conversation when the specific identity is beside the point or needs to stay private.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧{某社|ぼうしゃ}: a major (unnamed) company
- {某社|ぼうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: an employee of a certain company
- {某社|ぼうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get a job at a certain company

RELATED {某|ぼう}〜 WORDS:
- ⟦{某所|ぼうしょ}→某所：26015_bousho⟧: a certain place
- {某氏|ぼうし}: a certain person (male)
- {某国|ぼうこく}: a certain country
- {某日|ぼうじつ}: a certain day
